step_id: # EXAMPLE — delete this line. One row per executed step, appended as you go (Gate 2).
# No BOM at the start of this file, and none needed: the verifier reads utf-8-sig.
# started_at / ended_at are ISO-8601 and must fall inside run_started_at..run_ended_at.
# authored_by is one of: agent | human | agent+human
# deviation  : met | deviated | unknown  (added in framework 1.1.0)
#              `deviated` — deliberately not followed; the reason, scope and expected
#                           impact live in the decision log. Requires at least one row
#                           in error-ledger.tsv: a recorded deviation is a decision, and
#                           a decision with no effect is rare enough to be worth stating.
#              `unknown`  — not established. This blocks delivery until it is resolved;
#                           a deviation state nobody established is a defect, not a
#                           decision, which is why it is not a free default.
